reputation._doc: Reputation in a settlement (v0.7.17, ReputationRules): points of the hero in a pack location with settlement: true; thresholds → steps −3…+3 (names); points by the engine's facts; master_max — the master's effect for a deed the place learned of; prices of every trader of the place (buy_pct the hero pays, sell_pct the trader pays) and the attitude of the people not dealt with yet (stranger_attitude).

discount._doc: A trader's discount by words (v0.7.15.2, effect npc_discount): min_pct..max_pct off buying, `days` days; only from an NPC with attitude ≥ min_attitude or one won over by a social check this turn.

thresholds._doc: Attitude thresholds (v0.7.15.3): at refuse_at and below the NPC will not talk or trade; at eager_at and above it offers help by its own roles and services.

favor._doc: A service of the NPC for free (v0.7.15.2, effect npc_favor): attitude ≥ min_attitude or won over this turn; one per NPC in cooldown_days.

conditions.blinded: Ослеплён: автоматически проваливает проверки, требующие зрения (Внимательность, Анализ); атаки по нему с преимуществом, его атаки с помехой.
conditions.charmed: Очарован: не может атаковать очаровавшего; тот совершает с преимуществом социальные проверки против него.
conditions.deafened: Оглох: ничего не слышит и автоматически проваливает проверки, требующие слуха.
conditions.exhaustion: Истощение: шесть степеней — 1: помеха на проверки; 2: скорость вдвое меньше; 3: помеха на атаки и спасброски; 4: максимум хитов вдвое меньше; 5: скорость 0; 6: смерть. Долгий отдых снимает всё.
conditions.frightened: Испуган: помеха на проверки и атаки, пока источник страха в поле зрения; не может к нему приближаться.
conditions.grappled: Схвачен: скорость 0; вырваться — действием, Атлетика или Акробатика.
conditions.incapacitated: Недееспособен: не может совершать действия и реакции; говорить и проходить проверки может.
conditions.invisible: Невидим: его нельзя увидеть без магии; его атаки с преимуществом, атаки по нему с помехой.
conditions.paralyzed: Парализован: недееспособен, не двигается и не говорит, проваливает спасброски Силы и Ловкости; атаки по нему с преимуществом, вплотную — критические.
conditions.petrified: Окаменел: недееспособен, сопротивление всему урону, проваливает спасброски Силы и Ловкости; атаки по нему с преимуществом.
conditions.poisoned: Отравлен: помеха на броски атаки и проверки характеристик.
conditions.prone: Лежит ничком: помеха на атаки; атаки по нему вблизи с преимуществом, издалека с помехой; встать — всё перемещение хода.
conditions.restrained: Опутан: скорость 0, помеха на атаки и спасброски Ловкости, атаки по нему с преимуществом.
conditions.stunned: Ошеломлён: недееспособен, проваливает спасброски Силы и Ловкости; атаки по нему с преимуществом.
conditions.unconscious: Без сознания: недееспособен, роняет всё, лежит ничком; атаки по нему с преимуществом, вплотную — критические.

glossary.advantage: Преимущество: бросаются две d20, берётся большая. Помеха — меньшая.
glossary.short_rest: Короткий отдых: не меньше часа; можно тратить Кости хитов.
glossary.long_rest: Долгий отдых: 8 часов; восстанавливает все хиты и половину Костей хитов. В этой игре снимает блокировку проваленных проверок.

spellcasting._doc: subclass_spells_ignored: the SRD import keeps Circle of the Land spells as one list for all terrains — not granted until the terrain picks them (backlog).

trade._doc: Trade (v0.5.3): buy = value × attitude % × (1 − haggle %), rounded up; sell = value × sell_ratio × attitude sell % × (1 + haggle %), rounded down. Haggle: Persuasion or Deception vs DC by attitude; the margin picks the tier; a failure locks haggling with this merchant until the next day.

demand._doc: Demand (v0.7.17.1): what a trader buys gladly (`wants` of the pack NPC; else the item types that make default_share of its stock), what it will not buy (`shuns`), the rest — other goods. Tags of an item: its item_type, magic (not common), scroll, tool and its own `tags`. The sell price: value × sell_ratio × wanted / other × saturation (each unit of the same item sold lately −saturation_step, down to saturation_floor; recover_per_day units a day) × attitude × reputation × haggle, within min_ratio…max_ratio of the value.

xp._doc: Experience only from combat (by monster CR) and quests of the pack (v0.5.4); the master cannot grant it.

resources._doc: Feature uses (v0.6.0): who has them (features), how many (max: fixed | class_specific with default | ability_mod with min and plus | per_level), when they come back (short | long; short_with: a feature that makes it short). on_use: what the engine does itself (heal [count, sides, bonus] where bonus may be "level"; heal_amount — heals the points spent). combat_cost: what a use costs in a fight (action by default, bonus, free).

rest._doc: short_rest_slot_features: who gets spell slots back on a short rest (warlock's Pact Magic).

consumables._doc: Items the engine applies when used (v0.6.0): heal [count, sides, bonus], remove [conditions]. Thrown in a fight (v0.7.12, the «Предметы» tab, PHB): `throw` — a ranged attack (improvised: no proficiency; range ft) and on a hit `damage` [dice, type] (only to `types` when given), `burning` dice at the start of the foe's turn until a DEX save DC 10 puts it out, `oiled` — the next fire damage to the foe +N, `condition` with an escape (a STR save each turn, `escape_dc`) on foes up to `max_size`. A catalog item may carry its own `use` (potions, the ointment, scrolls, wands).

condition_effects._doc: What a condition does to engine checks (SRD; v0.7.8): checks | skills {id} | saves {ability} | senses {sight, hearing}: disadvantage | auto_fail. A sense comes with the master's check (a check that needs sight or hearing). Incapacitated and stunned heroes still make checks: the master decides whether they can try.

trait_cantrips._doc: Cantrips a race trait grants (the SRD import has no spell list in traits, v0.6.0).

theft._doc: Theft (v0.7.0): the pockets of an NPC — the pack's `pockets` list or by its monster template (pockets: coins_dice × unit_cp in a purse, item_count things of `items`, worn weapons of the SRD statblock). DC of an entry = max(10, passive Perception) + dc modifiers. Caught (or a thing of the owner taken before its eyes) — caught_attitude, then the reaction by template (reactions; traders close the shop for the day): fight, call_guard (fine_cp, or a fight with guard_monster when the player cannot pay). Words without the window take only the purse.

reward_budget._doc: The master's rewards between long rests (v0.7.14.3, DMG treasure by level): coins and things the master gives (`coins` up, `give_item` outside quests) together cost at most per_rest_cp of the hero's level until the next long rest; quest rewards, fights, thefts and searches are not counted. A success on a nearly_impossible check this turn lets the master give at most impossible_share of what is left.

crime._doc: Crimes of the hero (v0.7.14, CrimeRules): a pack NPC killed in a fight the hero began. Witnesses (the living NPCs of the room) know at once and like the hero witness_attitude less; a hidden body is found after found_minutes. Known — every NPC of the location attitude; in a location with `law` (pack) the hero is wanted: traders and givers turn away, a guard NPC or a patrol (after search_minutes) holds the hero — wergild fine_cp a crime (×notable_mult for a victim with notable_tags), or stocks_days a crime in the stocks, or a fight with patrol_size guards. Settled — the location forgives `forgiven`. A body gives its pockets and body_wares things of its wares.

props._doc: Things of the rooms (v0.7.0): the master furnishes a room on its first visit — up to max_per_room things; portable ones are catalog items, each worth at most item_value_cap_cp, together at most room_value_cap_cp of the character's level.

time._doc: Time of day (v0.6.3): minutes since midnight. A step between rooms of one location — move_minutes, into another location — travel_minutes; a short rest — short_rest_minutes; a long rest ends at wake_minute. Parts start at `from`; night — traders closed (night_shops_closed), darkness outside lit locations.

combat._doc: Combat (v0.6.1, ADR-0010 §7): 7 columns of 30 ft on a line (−3…3), the player starts at 0; a move is one column (speed ≥ 60 — two), Dash one more. Spells the engine resolves itself — engine_spells (the rest go to the master as improvisation); multi: several darts or rays. Morale: a WIS save at half HP or when the leader falls; intelligent foes (INT ≥ intelligent_int) surrender, the rest flee. XP budget per character level for the master's fights (DMG, hard); in a fight the master's reinforcement keeps the foes in play within it and comes after reinforce_delay rounds; a foe's call for help (pack encounter help) — after help_delay.

condition_spells._doc: Condition spells the engine resolves (v0.6.5): conditions for `rounds` (foe turns), a save against the spell DC (or a hit point `pool` + `pool_per_slot` — the weakest first), `repeat_save` at the end of the foe's turn, `ends_on_damage`, `types` it works on / `immune_types`, `immune_condition` (Sleep: those immune to charm), `min_int`, `area` (the target's column; range 0 — the player's).

lore_skills._doc: Inspect a foe (v0.6.6): the knowledge skill by creature type, DC = lore_base_dc + CR rounded up; success opens the kind for good.

parley._doc: Parley in a fight (v0.6.2; a challenge since v0.7.5): every try costs the action and rolls Intimidation or Persuasion against DC = base_dc + the best WIS save of intelligent foes + per_cr × the highest CR among them + per_defeated for every foe out of the fight + per_bloodied for every foe below half HP + hard (an encounter of the pack with "parley": "hard" — finales, fanatics), not below min_dc. `successes` before `failures` win: the skill of the deciding success sets the outcome (Intimidation — surrender or flight, Persuasion — truce); `failures` — they will not listen until the end of the fight.

carry._doc: Carrying capacity (v0.7.7, PHB): Strength × per_str pounds; over it the hero cannot leave the room. Coins weigh nothing in this version.

equip_minutes._doc: Changing armour out of a fight (v0.7.7, PHB): minutes to don / doff by category; a shield and weapons take no minutes (in a fight a shield and armour cannot change, a weapon is drawn free once a turn, then for the action).

invisibility._doc: Invisibility (v0.7.5): the hero is invisible with the condition `invisible` or while concentrating on one of `spells`. Those who would see them get `passive_penalty` off passive Perception (5e disadvantage); in a fight the hero attacks with advantage and is attacked with disadvantage; an attack or a spell ends a spell with ends_on_attack (5e Invisibility; Greater Invisibility stays). Talking does not end it: NPCs hear a voice.

hero_effects._doc: Effects on the hero (v0.7.8): a condition or a boon with its source, duration, save and concentration. Durations are in rounds (10 a minute) of the game clock: round, minute, ten_minutes, hour, eight_hours; or short_rest / long_rest / until_removed. A save names its tag (save_tags): race traits give advantage against it (trait_saves) or immunity (trait_immune). Damage to the hero: resistances of race traits (trait_resist; damage_resistance — the draconic ancestry), of Rage, of items (item_resist), of effects; petrified — resistance to all. spell_cures: what a spell cast on the hero lifts (remove), how much exhaustion it takes away, and the boon it leaves (adv_tag, resist, duration). exhaustion: forced march — each hour of travel past march_hours a day, a CON save DC march_dc + hours past; a day awake — each awake_hours without a long rest, a CON save DC awake_dc + awake_dc_step per day before; a long rest takes all exhaustion away (decision of the author, ADR-0010). camp: a long rest outside an inn costs `need` points of food (food: item → points).

class_features._doc: Class features in the engine (v0.7.10, FeatureRules): Font of Magic — sorcery points for a slot by circle; metamagic — the cost in points and what it does (quickened: a bonus action; empowered: the damage dice twice, the better; heightened: the first save of the target with disadvantage; distant: double range; extended: double rounds); careful, twinned and subtle stay with the master (no allies, social). Sacred Weapon lasts 10 rounds; Song of Rest — a die on a short rest when hit dice are spent.

languages._doc: Languages (v0.7.11, LanguageRules): NPCs of the pack without `languages` speak Common and the language of their people (by_race: the start of the Russian race word). understand_spells: a spell cast on oneself that lets the hero understand every tongue for an hour.

backgrounds._doc: Background features (v0.7.11, BackgroundRules): `ties` — the tag of the pack's NPCs who like the hero from the start (+1 attitude) and `tie_text` for the master; temple_rest — a free long rest in a room tagged temple; forage — a camp without food once a day outside settlements; wayfinder — a quarter less on the way outside settlements; stage_lodging — a show on a stage gives a free room that night; `master` — the rule for the master. _perform — the pay of a show by the Performance total.

acolyte.master: в храмах своей веры героя приютят, накормят и вылечат бесплатно; единоверцы помогают

criminal.tie_text: связной: знает героя по преступному миру
criminal.master: у героя есть связной в преступном мире: через него можно передать весть, найти скупщика, узнать то, что прячут от стражи

folk_hero.tie_text: простой человек: уважает героя из народа, спрячет и накормит
folk_hero.master: простые люди укроют героя, если он не опасен им самим, и не выдадут страже

soldier.master: солдаты и стража уважают звание героя: слушают, пропускают, дают на время коня или снаряжение

sage.master: если герой чего-то не знает, он знает, где и у кого это узнать: подскажи место или человека из мира

outlander.master: герой помнит карты и местность, вне поселений находит еду и воду для себя (лагерь без припасов раз в день)

entertainer.master: за выступление в таверне или на площади герою дают ночлег и еду; публика его узнаёт

tools._doc: Tools in checks (v0.7.11, BackgroundRules.tool_check): the master's check names `tool`; the hero proficient with it and carrying it adds the proficiency bonus, or gets advantage when also proficient in a skill of `skills` (XGtE); `required` — without the tool the check fails (a lock without thieves' tools).

item_rules._doc: Items by 5e (v0.7.12, ItemRules): attunement — up to `attune_max` items, an hour with the item (`attune_minutes`) out of a fight; a found magic item (rarity above common) is unidentified until a short rest with it, an attunement, Identify or a trader's service; ammunition by the weapon (`ammo`), half the spent comes back after the fight (`recover`); `element_dice` — the extra damage of a weapon with fire_damage and the like; `small_races` — heavy weapons with disadvantage; `scrolls` — DC and attack bonus by the circle (DMG); `max_found_rarity` — what the master may hand out at levels 1-5 (quest rewards of the pack excepted).

services._doc: Services of NPCs (NPC `services` in the pack; a pack may add its own in world.json `services`), v0.7.16 by pillar 6 — a service is data over an operation of the engine (`op`): identify — every unknown item the hero carries; lift_curse — the cursed items come off (they stay cursed); enchant — one carried item of `needs` (weapon | armor | any) from the catalog gets `property` from the item properties and the name «… (`suffix`)», its value + the cost. `name` — the button, `short` — for the lines and the master, `done` — the line of the result. Silver: PHB 100 gp.

spell_effects._doc: Spells that change numbers (v0.7.13, SpellEffects): on the hero — die (a bonus die to the rolls of `on`: attack, save, check; `once` — one roll), next_attack_adv, immune [conditions], temp_hp each turn (MOD — the spellcasting modifier); on foes (`foe`) — a save of up to `targets` foes (+1 per slot above), a failed one keeps the minus die on its attacks and saves. Defenses (v0.7.13.2): ac_base (unarmored: base + DEX), ac_plus, ac_min; attackers_dis; images (Mirror Image: d20 6/8/11+ hits an image, AC 10 + DEX); sanctuary (a WIS save or no attack; ends when the hero attacks a foe); temp_dice (+temp_per_slot); max_hp_plus (+per_slot) with as much healing; resist / resist_auto (the most common damage type of the foes, fire by default), adv_tag, remove; foe_types_dis — those types attack with disadvantage; save_adv [abilities], death_adv, max_heal (healing rolls its maximum). Movement and form (v0.7.13.3): speed_x2 and haste (one more action: one weapon attack, Dash, Disengage, Dodge; a turn of lethargy when it ends), flying (foes without a ranged attack cannot reach the hero), blink (d20 11+ at the end of the hero's turn — gone until their next turn), speed_plus, bonus_dash, teleport (a column away from the nearest foe, no opportunity attacks), enlarged, darkvision, see_invisible, skill_bonus, ability_adv (best — the hero's highest ability). On the weapon (v0.7.13.4): shillelagh [bases] — the spellcasting ability, d8, magic; weapon_plus (plus_at_slot); weapon_extra [dice, type] on every hit; next_hit — the next hit's dice by the slot (next_dice); mark — +dice on hits at the marked foe (foe_target: cast at a foe; moved by a bonus action when it falls); blade — a melee spell attack with blade_dice by the slot. Sustained (v0.7.13.5): `sustained` — attack (a spell attack again each turn by `cost`; drain — half back as hit points), heat (the same foe takes the dice, CON save or disadvantage on its attacks), strike (a save in the target's column), zone (a column of the field: a save or damage when a foe starts its turn there, enters it or ends its turn there; `follow` — the hero's column; `move` — columns the button moves it; `ram` — the sphere strikes where it moves; `slow` — a foe in it moves half); `dice` — when the spell has no damage by slot (spike growth: 2d4 per 5 ft ≈ 6d4 per 30-ft column). Control (v0.7.13.6): zones — `now` (at once on who stands there), `cond` (a failed save lays it: Grease — prone), obscure (Fog Cloud, Darkness: attacks into or out of the column have disadvantage, inside both — even), silence (no spells with a verbal component inside), retch (Stinking Cloud: the turn is lost), block_ranged (Wind Wall: ranged weapon attacks through the column miss); push (Gust of Wind: a STR save or a column away, `reach` columns); `curse` — a flag on foes by a save (or a spell attack): outlined (Faerie Fire: advantage at it, no invisibility), enfeebled (half damage of its weapons), cursed_dis (its attacks at the hero with disadvantage), slowed_spell (AC −2, half the way, no reactions, one attack); `repeat` — a save at the end of its turn ends it. Reactions (v0.7.13.7, the window «Использовать?»): `reaction` hit (Shield: +5 AC until the hero's turn, the hit may miss), damage (Hellish Rebuke: the attacker takes the dice, DEX half), spell (Counterspell: a foe's spell of circle 3 or less fails, higher — a check DC 10 + circle); dispel (Dispel Magic: the target foe's spells on the hero end; calmed — Calm Emotions: the foe lowers its weapon); npc_save (out of a fight: the NPC's save by its monster template, `types` it works on; the master narrates the outcome); lift_curse; make — items made (Goodberry, Create Food and Water). The world (v0.7.13.8): light — a light source while it lasts (darkness goes); reveal — trap (Find Traps: the room's traps are found) or magic (Detect Magic: caches with magic things are found, unknown things in the pack show their aura); knock — the room's closed things open, loudly.
